properties.NAME: KNOX
properties.CHANGE: KNOX exchanged small areas along the Wabash River with Illinois Territory when the state of Indiana was created from Indiana, Illinois, and Michigan Territories.
properties.CITATION: (U.S. Stat., vol. 3, ch. 57 [1816], secs. 1-2/p. 289 and res. 1 [1816]/p. 399; Van Zandt, 115)
